title: Tactile feedback, skeleton affordance, and deferred-loading patterns for icon clusters
creator: Rina Patel
description:
Problem statement:
Icon-only clusters and compact action groups currently show inconsistent feedback across themes and densities. Observed issues: press latency (perceived press lag), spinner overlap with icons during deferred loading, hit-target regressions in compact mode, and theme-aware color fallbacks that break in high-contrast modes. This ticket defines a cohesive tactile and loading strategy for icon clusters and single icon buttons that:
- Provides immediate tactile feedback (visual press states + reduced motion option)
- Introduces a lightweight skeleton/ghost affordance for near-instant operations vs deferred spinner for long ops
- Standardizes deferred-loading thresholds and transition timings
- Ensures spinner/icon placement does not shift layout or exceed hit targets
- Uses semantic tokens so colors adapt across light/dark/high-contrast themes

Scope (in-scope):
- New visual specs for press, hold, and cancel states for icon-only buttons and grouped icon clusters
- Skeleton placeholder token and transition pattern to swap to spinner after threshold
- Compact-mode hit target enforcement and micro-adjustments to padding tokens
- Theme token mapping for spinner color and backdrop in high-contrast modes
- Acceptance criteria and QA checklist for regression verification

Out-of-scope:
- Global changes to primary/secondary full-width button tokens (separate tickets exist)

Trade-offs considered: 
- Immediate spinner on press reduces perceived latency but causes layout jitter and heavier visual noise; deferred spinner with skeleton reduces churn but requires a careful threshold to avoid missing quick operations. We propose a 200ms skeleton -> 350ms spinner threshold as a starting point (see decisions).

Acceptance criteria:
- Icon-only buttons show an instantaneous press overlay (0ms) using a semantic token (button-press-overlay) and revert within 120ms by default unless operation ongoing
- For ops <200ms, show brief skeleton fade (50–100ms) and no spinner; for ops >350ms, transition to compact spinner centered over icon without changing hitbox size
- No layout shift across theme/density combinations (compact/regular/comfort). Verified on chrome, safari, and firefox on macOS and Windows high-contrast mode
- All color tokens map to high-contrast alternatives; verify using accessibility contrast tools
- QA checklist items completed and regression tests added to visual snapshot suite

Design artifacts and spec files are linked below.
comments: 2025-02-14 - Rina Patel: Created initial ticket after spike with Eng. Spike revealed that compact hit-target reductions were causing accidental taps in .mobile density. Proposed solution: enforce min 40x40px effective hit area via pseudo padding in layout-only elements.
2025-02-17 - Maya Chen (PM): Confirming priority — this ties to a recent regression reported by two customers. Please add regression labels and include a short rollout note for Console teams.

2025-02-19 - Ethan Brooks (Eng): Reviewed token suggestions. Concern: spinner overlay currently uses z-index that conflicts with focus ring on some platforms. Suggest changing spinner placement to be inside the icon container and using border-based focus ring to avoid overlap. Assigned to Eng for validation.

2025-02-21 - Liam O'Connor (Assignee): Prototype in Figma updated with skeleton + spinner transition, and compact padding tokens now reference semantic token 'button-hit-min'. Uploaded updated frames. Next: produce CSS token mapping and a small interactive HTML demo for engineering to test thresholds.

2025-02-25 - Accessibility review (Nina Alvarez): Recommend reduced-motion flag respected for both skeleton and spinner transitions; ensure focus-visible state never suppressed. Also flagged color pair for dark theme; suggested alternate semantic token 'spinner-contrast' for high-contrast mode.

2025-03-01 - Design review (Panel): Approved visual language for press overlay and skeleton but requested numbers for timings be made configurable via token overrides. Agreed on default thresholds: 200ms skeleton delay, 350ms spinner show, 120ms press overlay decay.

2025-03-04 - Liam O'Connor: Engineering prototype integrated into /pr/1987. Visual snapshots added for compact/regular across all themes. Found one regression: in RTL languages the spinner x-offset is off by 6px; filed ENG-932 for engineering fix. Marking design handoff ready once ENG-932 is merged.
qa_checklist: Verify press overlay appears instantly and disappears after 120ms when op completes
Confirm skeleton appears at 200ms for quick ops and fades for ops that finish before spinner threshold
Validate spinner appears at 350ms and is centered over icon without changing layout
Run visual regression snapshots for compact/regular/comfort densities across light/dark/high-contrast themes
Confirm min hit area enforced in compact mode (>=40x40 effective) and no accidental layout shifts
Confirm reduced-motion media query suppresses skeleton/spinner fades but preserves instant press overlay
Contrast check spinner and overlay tokens against WCAG AA/AAA where appropriate
